hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/ross-prairie-trailhead-campground/experiences-amenities ('Ross Prairie is a full-service campground with 14 sites, each available with 30- and 50-amp electrical pedestals as well as potable water hookups') + Reserve Florida unit details (all 14 units Electric Hookup 50), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14 pull-through sites on a compacted shell surface, every one with high tie posts for horses (portable stalls/pens allowed). Reserve Florida lists nine at 56-86 ft and five at 20 ft.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/ross-prairie-trailhead-campground/experiences-amenities ('14 sites', 'equestrian camping facilities with high tie posts at all 14 sites', 'the compacted shell surface within the equestrian friendly campground for overnight guests') + Reserve Florida search/grid and search/details for facilities 158-162 (all 14 units Pull Through; VehicleLength 20-86), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bathhouse, picnic pavilions and a horse wash-down area in the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/ross-prairie-trailhead-campground/experiences-amenities ('Picnic pavilions, a dump station and a bathhouse are available in the campground', 'a designated horse wash-down area in the campground'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on the Florida State Parks reservations website (Reserve Florida) or at 800-326-3521.

note: Equestrian-friendly trailhead campground on the Cross Florida Greenway, about 14 miles of horse trails from the campground. --Claude

AWH's note line was all structured facts (now in fields); replaced.
